tbesh_html:
Galeed = "witness heap"
the pile of stones heaped up between Jacob and Laban to certify their covenant; located on Mt Gilead
Another name of ra.mot gi.l.ad (רָמֹת "Ramoth" H7433)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Galed, a memorial cairn East of the Jordan
strongs_1890.derivation: from H1530 (גַּל) and H5707 (עֵד); heap of testimony;
